title: Rippers Unmasked — Guise
description: The Guise (mask / identity swap) as a first-class Project FU classFeature, on the Arcanist Arcanum pattern: hold several guises, bind one to make it active (dismissing any other), and its embedded ActiveEffect deltas apply on swap. Registers 'guise' on FU's module-open classFeature registry — no system fork. Original campaign content. A personal-table module — not for redistribution.

rippers-guise.note: v0.7.0 GUISE-BUILDER-FIX (ROS-24): the Builder was under-constrained (every affinity could be Absorption) and missing core fields. Guardrails now enforced: EXACTLY 3 distinct classes (Q4); the affinity TRIO — one Immunity + one Vulnerability + one Resistance, an Immunity MUST be paired with a Vulnerability, and ABSORPTION IS NEVER OFFERED (Q6/Q7); the un-canon 'Governing skill' + 'Max forms collectable' monstrous controls are REMOVED (Q7). Missing fields wired: Guise Equipment (was hardcoded []), Perk (curated list), a +3 Bonus with a check-type selector (Q3 — PROVISIONAL taxonomy: Accuracy/Magic/Open/Opposed/Group; Austin to confirm/adjust live), a narrative Bane (Q2), a Tell, a narrative flaw, and a plain-text Nature (Q5). NEW Innate-Guise mode (Q1): two Specialties + one creation Heroic (creation-banned heroics refused), no armour/hands/affinities/perk/tell — a worn guise never carries a Heroic. 6-step wizard (Identity/Classes/Skills/Loadout/Affinities/Review). Headless tests 37/37. Registers a first-class 'guise' classFeature (Arcanum pattern) via CONFIG.FU.classFeatureRegistry. No FU content redistributed.
